jobs.text: شده آخر شب، یه آهنگ رو هی از اول بذاری؟
jobs.prompt: The same woman in the reference asks a short friendly question, speaking naturally to the camera with accurate small lip and jaw movement, gentle head motion and occasional natural blinking. Preserve her exact face, black scarf, hair, embroidered clothes, jewelry and posture. No broad gestures or large turns. Her lips relax closed at the end. A perfectly fixed camera and uniform flat green background.

The same woman quietly listens attentively. Her lips stay gently CLOSED the entire time. She does NOT speak or sing or mouth words. Subtle slow head nod, one natural blink and a brief downward glance, then a calm gaze toward camera. Preserve her exact face, black scarf, hair, embroidered clothes and jewelry. No large gestures. A perfectly fixed camera and uniform flat green background.

conditions: No camera pans/zooms over still image as a substitute
NO singer/music vocals in listening conditioning
Microphone, covers, gallery and logo composited separately and remain fixed
Check identity, Persian lip sync and listening closed mouth by human viewing before full production
Frame-change checks alone do not certify phoneme sync or naturalness
